title: 1816 Prairie stands on its pale stone basement
items: The Henderson house at 1816 Prairie now stands on the pale stone basement its old photograph shows. The stone runs from the ground up to the main floor, around the front, both bay windows and the south side, with barred cellar windows under the bays.
The two raised roofs over its bay windows are now slated like the rest of the roof, not plain grey, and each has a dormer window where the photograph shows one.
Still to do: a second dormer on the side roof, the carved window hoods and the taller iron balcony over the door.
